vulnerability_analysis: The INCOME token contract has owner-only functions that allow setting arbitrary fee percentages. The owner can abuse this privilege by setting extremely high fees (e.g., 99% total fee) and then selling tokens. The fees are distributed to marketing wallet (which owner can set to their address) and dividend tracker (which owner can claim from). This allows the owner to extract value from token holders.
attack_strategy: 1. Impersonate the contract owner using vm.prank. 2. Set marketing wallet to attacker address. 3. Set fees to extremely high values (e.g., BNBRewardsFee=95, marketingFee=5, liquidityFee=0). 4. Acquire INCOME tokens (we'll need some to sell). 5. Sell tokens to trigger fee collection. 6. Claim dividends from dividend tracker. 7. Profit from both marketing fee and BNB rewards.
step_by_step_plan: 1. Start prank as owner. 2. Call setMarketingWallet(attacker). 3. Call setFee(95, 0, 5) for 100% total fee. 4. Get INCOME tokens - we can transfer from owner to attacker since owner has tokens minted in constructor. 5. Approve router for token spending. 6. Sell tokens via swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens. 7. Claim dividends via dividendTracker.processAccount(). 8. Stop prank and verify profit.
